summary: Notifications Module Testing Complete - All 33 pytest tests passed. All 7 notification types tested and working: welcome_member, post_approved, post_rejected, member_banned, discussion_reply, new_event, join_request_received. Template CRUD, locking, overrides, delivery logs, and RBAC all functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 default notification templates correctly seeded (welcome_member, post_approved, post_rejected, member_banned, discussion_reply, new_event email+whatsapp, join_request_received)
Template locking works correctly - locked templates cannot be overridden by managers (returns 403)
Community template overrides work correctly - managers can customize unlocked templates
RBAC properly enforced: only super_admin can access /api/admin/notifications/* routes, only community_manager or super_admin can access /api/manager/communities/{slug}/notifications/* routes

All notification triggers integrated: join_request_received (on join request to private community), welcome_member (on join request approval), member_banned (on ban), discussion_reply (on reply to thread by non-author), post_approved (on thread approval), post_rejected (on thread rejection), new_event (on send-event)
Template placeholder rendering works correctly - {{user_name}}, {{community_name}}, {{thread_title}} etc. are replaced in notification body and subject
Delivery logs correctly stored with status (sent/failed), recipient info, rendered content
MockProvider correctly simulates email/whatsapp sends without actual delivery (all sends return success)
Audience segmentation works: all, member, moderator, community_manager segments supported for event notifications
seed_data_creation: Created test users for notification trigger testing. Test communities: event-test (public), private-notif (private). Multiple notification logs created during testing.
